title: Peterson and CIA director Woolsey invite Steven Greer to dinner

tellings.quote: and his wife uh along with uh James Woolsey, CIA director at the time, and his wife were the people who invited Steven Greer to a uh dinner in the early 90s

plain: In the early 1990s, a man named John Peterson and his wife, along with James Woolsey, then director of the CIA, and his wife, are said to have invited Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for the release of UFO secrets, to dinner near Washington. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells this as something he heard from the people involved. If true, it would mean the head of the CIA was quietly sitting down with a leading UFO campaigner.
